LeBron James vs. Knicks — Opening Night
**Key verified facts (HIGH confidence):**
- NBA regular season opens October 19-20, 2026
- Opening Night: Knicks host 76ers at Madison Square Garden — ring night for New York's 2026 champions
- LeBron James signed 2-year deal with Sixers; joined Embiid + Jaylen Brown
- LeBron turns 42 in December 2026; entering his 24th NBA season
- Knicks swept the 76ers in the 2026 second round
- Knicks re-signed Brunson, Towns (KAT), Shamet, Alvarado, Clarkson, Diawara, added Drummond
- Training camp opens September 28 (veterans); NBA calendar from NBA.com
- Preseason begins October 3; Opening Night October 20

research.facts:
Kawhi Leonard Trade Pending
**Key verified facts (HIGH confidence):**
- NBA investigating undisclosed sponsorship between Leonard and Clippers partner Aspiration
- Trade terms: Kawhi → Toronto for Brandon Ingram + Gradey Dick + 2031 UPF + 2033 UPF + 2027 swap + 2 2nds
- Kawhi expected to be at Raptors training camp Sept. 28 in Quebec City
- Trade "cleared" the initial hurdle Sept. 2 but full league ratification held pending investigation
